claim_text: Despite this, we made significant progress in decarbonisation through the commissioning of the North Star Junction solar farm which generated 180 GWh, meeting 25 per cent of Iron Bridge’s current electricity needs, and helped avoid additional emissions from the Solomon gas power station.
metric_name: North Star Junction solar generation; Iron Bridge current electricity needs met; Total Group Scope 1 emissions; Group Scope 1 and 2 emissions (location-based); Group Scope 1 and 2 location-based emissions intensity
context_text: Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions FY25 EMISSIONS (MTCO₂-E) FY24 EMISSIONS (MTCO₂-E) VARIANCE Total Group Scope 1 2.64 2.36 12.0%.；Despite this, we made significant progress in decarbonisation through the commissioning of the North Star Junction solar farm which generated 180 GWh, meeting 25 per cent of Iron Bridge’s current electricity needs, and helped avoid additional emissions from the Solomon gas power station. Overall PEC emissions intensity has improved by 18 per cent in FY25 with the introduction of this 100MW solar farm.；Group Scope 1 and 2 emissions (location-based) FY25 3.02 FY24 2.72 VARIANCE 10.9%.；Group Scope 1 and 2 location-based emissions intensity FY25 0.015 FY24 0.014 VARIANCE 7.1%.；The 10.9 per cent increase in Scope 1 and 2 emissions combined with a 3.5 per cent increase in ore produced, resulted in a seven per cent increase in emissions intensity in FY25.
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: 太阳能项目和PEC局部强度改善可证明存在项目层面的进展，但集团Scope 1及Scope 1+2总量与强度均上升，无法充分支撑“significant progress”这一整体性表述，存在夸大漂绿嫌疑。
